title: Spec metadata
description: Schema for a spec folder's metadata.json under documentation/specs/<task>/. Each spec folder groups an audit and/or design plans for one body of work; metadata.json describes the set and its provenance. Referenced by each metadata.json via its "$schema" key.

$schema.description: Path or URI of this schema, so editors validate the file. Typically the relative path "../metadata.schema.json".

title.description: Human-readable name for the whole spec set.

description.description: One- or two-sentence summary of what this spec set covers.

repository.description: The GitHub repository the work targets, as "owner/repo".

branch.description: The development branch the work lives on.

pullRequest.description: URL of the pull request tracking the work, if one is open.

commit.description: Git commit the metadata was last reconciled against (a full or abbreviated SHA-1).

subject.description: Optional, domain-specific subject of the spec set. Free-form; the keys below are the conventional ones for a protocol-conformance spec, but any subject shape is allowed.

protocol.description: The protocol or standard the spec concerns, e.g. "A2A (Agent2Agent)".

documents.description: The documents that make up this spec set, in reading order.

generatedAt.description: When the metadata was generated or last regenerated (UTC, RFC 3339).

timestamp.description: An RFC 3339 date-time. `format` is advisory (most validators don't assert it), so the pattern enforces the shape: e.g. "2026-07-18T19:18:51Z".

path.description: Path to the document, relative to this metadata.json's folder. A Markdown file; may sit in a subfolder (e.g. "plans/telemetry.md").

title.description: The document's title (matches its top-level H1).

kind.description: The document's role in the set. "audit" is an assessment of current state; "plan" is a design for a change built on it.

created.description: When the document was first added (UTC, RFC 3339).

updated.description: When the document was last edited (UTC, RFC 3339); equal to "created" if never edited.
